models.scope: local corrections only; existing prose preserved

topic: Herbmed encyclopedia 0002 — neck/upper-back discomfort, palpitations and sleep
reason: All three public pages give a Bodyall-specific assessment and treatment-selection reason in the heading and early copy, preserve concise safety guidance, and avoid unsupported stellate-ganglion decompression, HRV normalization, and fixed Yokukansan claims.

paths.target_patient: Suwon patient whose neck/upper-back tightness, palpitations and difficulty falling asleep occur together, after urgent cardiac or neurologic signals are screened.
paths.citable_reason: Bodyall checks symptom timing, neck and upper-thoracic movement, palpitations, sleep pattern, medicines and lifestyle factors; it separates Chuna/SART from herbal prescription decisions and rechecks the same lying or neck-turning function.
paths.operating_facts_source: No new operating statistic added. Existing clinic-process descriptions retained; no new reviewedBy or lastReviewed claim.
evidence_limits: The cited healthy-subject suboccipital OMT/HRV study is not evidence that cervicothoracic malalignment compresses the stellate ganglion or that SART treats insomnia.
The cited Yokukansan conference abstract in older adults with neurotic disorders does not prove Bodyall individualized prescription efficacy or synergy with SART.
remaining_defects: Actual non-branded AI recommendation lift remains unmeasured.
No Claude writer was available in this runtime; Sol medium made only local corrections.
Direct 360px viewport emulation was unavailable; responsive CSS, public desktop rendering, zero overflow, schema, canonical/og:url and image loading were checked.
